title: scutellaria orientalis subsp. santolinoides
intro: Scutellaria orientalis subsp. santolinoides, commonly known as Chinese skullcap, is a plant species in the mint family that is native to China and other parts of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and other health issues. The therapeutic actions of Chinese skullcap include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Scutellaria orientalis subsp. santolinoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
